sn2.19:1.2: As he was standing to one side, Uttara the deva’s son recited this verse in the Blessed One’s presence:
sn2.19:2.1:
“Life is swept along,
next-to-nothing its span.
sn2.19:2.2:
For one swept on by aging
no shelters exist.
sn2.19:2.4:
one should do deeds of merit
that bring about bliss.”
sn2.19:3.1:
The Buddha:
“Life is swept along,
next-to-nothing its span.
sn2.19:3.2:
For one swept to old age
no shelters exist.
sn2.19:3.4:
one should drop the world’s bait
and look for peace.”
